```{r import data}
#####################################
# PREPARE THE DATA
#####################################

# Clear the console and load packages
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))
library(rmarkdown)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)
library(cowplot)
options(scipen = 999, digits=3)

# Load in the training data spreadsheets
Data <- read.csv("SpokenLanguageTraining.csv")

# Tidy up the columns and make sure the columns are coded correctly
Data$Group <- as.character(Data$Experiment) # Whether participants received direct instruction - converted to factor in next block of code
Data$TestingGroup <- as.factor(Data$TestingGroup) # When participants were tested
Data$Task <- as.factor(Data$ExperimentName) # Experimental task
Data$Procedure <- as.character(Data$Procedure) # Experimental procedure within task (P-S vs. S-P) - converted to factor in next block of code
Data$Script <- as.factor(Data$Language) # Georgian vs. Hungrarian script
Data$Subject <- as.character(Data$Subject) # Participant - changed to factor later in function
Data$Trial <- as.numeric(Data$Trial) # Trial number within the task
Data$Phonology <- as.factor(Data$Phon) # Phonological form of stimulus
Data$Semantics <- as.factor(Data$Sem) # Semantic meaning of stimulus
Data$SemanticMarker <- as.character(Data$Systematic) # Whether final symbol systematically denoted the semantic category - - converted to factor in next block of code
Data$Acc <- as.integer(Data$Accuracy) # Accuracy: 1 = Correct, 0 = Incorrect

# Relabel Group and systematicity factors with clearer names
Data$Group[Data$Group == "Exp2"] = "Discovery"
Data$Group[Data$Group == "Exp3"] = "Explicit"
Data$SemanticMarker[Data$SemanticMarker == "1"] = "Systematic"
Data$SemanticMarker[Data$SemanticMarker == "0"] = "Arbitrary"

# Relabel procedure with clearer names
Data$Procedure[Data$Procedure == "TestHSProc"] = "Say Meaning"
Data$Procedure[Data$Procedure == "TestSSProc1"] = "Say Spoken Form"
Data$Procedure <- as.factor(Data$Procedure)

Data$Group <- as.factor(Data$Group)
Data$SemanticMarker<- as.factor(Data$SemanticMarker)

tidycolumns <- c("Group", "TestingGroup", "Task", "Procedure", "Script", "Subject", "Run", "Trial", "Phonology", "Semantics", "Category", "SemanticMarker", "Acc")
Data <- subset(Data, select = tidycolumns)

# Remove excluded participants
Data <- Data[Data$Subject != "317",] # Removed due to poor performance on final day tests
Data <- Data[Data$Subject != "318",] # Removed as did not complete the study past Session 1
Data$Subject <- as.factor(Data$Subject)

```


**Plots**  

``` {r training plot}

#####################################
# CREATE TABLES OF MEANS
#####################################

# Subject accuracy
SubjectAcc <- Data %>%
  group_by(Group, Subject) %>%
  summarise(subject_mean = mean(Acc),
            std_dev = sd(Acc),
            nrows = n(),
            std_err = std_dev / sqrt(nrows))

SubjectAcc_byprocedure <- Data %>%
  group_by(Group, Subject, Procedure) %>%
  summarise(subject_mean = mean(Acc),
            std_dev = sd(Acc),
            nrows = n(),
            std_err = std_dev / sqrt(nrows))

# Group accuracy - check if standard error should be for within subjects
GroupAcc <- SubjectAcc %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(group_mean = mean(subject_mean),
            std_dev = sd(subject_mean),
            nrows = n(),
            std_err = std_dev / sqrt(nrows))

GroupAcc_byprocedure <- SubjectAcc_byprocedure %>%
  group_by(Group, Procedure) %>%
  summarise(group_mean = mean(subject_mean),
            std_dev = sd(subject_mean),
            nrows = n(),
            std_err = std_dev / sqrt(nrows))


#####################################
# CREATE PLOTS
#####################################

# Use the same theme for all plots
apatheme <- theme_bw()+
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
        legend.position = "right",
        axis.line.x = element_line(color='black'),
        axis.line.y = element_line(color='black'),
        axis.text.y=element_text(color = 'black', margin = margin(r = 10)),
        axis.text.x=element_text(color = 'black'),
        strip.text.x = element_text(face="bold", size = 10, margin = margin(b = 10)),
        strip.background = element_blank())

# Create accuracy plot of subject and group level data  
training_plot <- ggplot(GroupAcc_byprocedure, aes(x = Group, y = group_mean))+
  geom_tile(aes(height = (std_err * 2), colour = Group, fill = Group), alpha = 0.5, size=0.2, width=0.5, position=position_dodge(0.65))+
  geom_jitter(data = SubjectAcc_byprocedure, aes(y = subject_mean), width = 0.01, shape = 21, alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_crossbar(aes(ymin= group_mean, ymax = group_mean, colour = Group), width = 0.6, position=position_dodge(0.65), size = 0.8)+
  geom_text(aes(y = 0.05, label = format(round(group_mean, digits=2), nsmall = 2)), size = 3)+
  xlab("")+ylab("Proportion Accuracy")+
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set1", guide = FALSE)+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", guide = FALSE)+
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,1))+
  coord_cartesian(clip = 'off')+
  ggtitle("Spoken Language Training")+
  facet_grid(. ~ Procedure)+
  apatheme
print(training_plot)

```
<br>
``` {r accuracy plot, include=TRUE, fig.height = 12, fig.width = 14, fig.align="center", fig.show='hold'}
print(training_plot)
```
<br>
**Training: Spoken Language - Say the Meaning**  
``` {r model say meaning, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results="hide"}

# Run the accuracy model for Saying Meaning
Data_SayMeaning <- Data[Data$Procedure == "Say Meaning",]
acc_LME_saymeaning <- glmer(Acc ~ Group + (1|Subject) + (1|Phonology) + (1|Semantics), family=binomial, data = Data_SayMeaning)

```
``` {r model summary say meaning, include=TRUE}
tab_model(acc_LME_saymeaning, transform = NULL, dv.labels = "Accuracy", pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Group"), show.ci = FALSE, show.se = TRUE, string.est = "Estimate", string.se = "SE", show.stat = TRUE)
tab_model(acc_LME_saymeaning, dv.labels = "Accuracy", pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Group"), show.ci = FALSE, show.se = TRUE, string.se = "SE", show.stat = TRUE)
```
<br>
**Training: Spoken Language - Say the Spoken Form**  
``` {r model say pronunciation, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results="hide"}
# Run the accuracy model for Saying Pronunciation
Data_SaySpokenForm <- Data[Data$Procedure == "Say Spoken Form",]
acc_LME_sayspokenform <- glmer(Acc ~ Group + (1|Subject) + (1|Phonology) + (1|Semantics), family=binomial, data = Data_SaySpokenForm)

```
``` {r model summary, include=TRUE}
tab_model(acc_LME_sayspokenform, transform = NULL, dv.labels = "Accuracy", pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Group"), show.ci = FALSE, show.se = TRUE, string.est = "Estimate", string.se = "SE", show.stat = TRUE)
tab_model(acc_LME_sayspokenform, dv.labels = "Accuracy", pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Group"), show.ci = FALSE, show.se = TRUE, string.se = "SE", show.stat = TRUE)
```
